Note: the annual report's exact domestic-vs-export revenue split was not retrieved within the tool budget, so the split itself is null.
note: Legal entity confirmed: the claimed name AWL AGRI BUSINESS LIMITED is the current registered name of the former Adani Wilmar Ltd (renamed after Adani exited the JV in FY24); both names appear as the same Ahmedabad Fortune House entity in customs data. Declared HS codes 151530/151620/151710/151790 (castor oil, vegetable fats, margarine) are broadly consistent with the observed trade: castor oil 151500 and hydrogenated castor oil 38231900 appear in records, while the largest visible export flows are actually 38231200 (oleic acid), 11010000 (atta) and 11063090 (besan) — i.e. the declared HS set is narrower than the real product mix; per project rule this is not a rejection ground, HS should be corrected to the observed codes. Industry claim 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) is only partly right: the oleic acid and castor-oil derivatives are oleochemicals, but the core business is edible oil and food FMCG. Export shipments are factual, not merely declared: dated B/Ls with destination ports and HS codes. Domestic supply is factual via audited listed-company turnover in the tens of thousands of crore rupees. Revenue: FY2025 (Mar-2025) consolidated sales Rs 63,672 Cr; FY2026 Rs 74,731 Cr (Screener.in). Export volume in USD/tonnes: null — not public in free views.
